name: Session Title
description:
The plugin makes a short title for a session. It sends the first prompt of the session one time to a model of the session provider with a low cost. It sends a maximum of 2000 characters. It saves the title in the session index. The plugin is off by default. To start it, set MINIMAL_AGENT_TITLE=1, or add the mode to plugins.title.modes in ~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc.

To stop it, set MINIMAL_AGENT_TITLE=0.

tool.name: SessionTitle
tool.description:
Set the title of this session. With `title`, the tool writes that title. Without `title`, the tool makes a new title from the user messages with a small model.

Use it only when the user tells you to set or change the title. Use it also when the work of the session changed much. Do not use it to read the title. Do not use it on each turn.

title.description: The new title, 2 to 6 words. Without it, the tool makes a title.

lock.description: If `true`, the tool writes a user title. Automatic titles do not replace it. Use `true` only with a `title` that the user gave you. The default is `false`.
